option_text: Tell me of your mission in the woods.
ReactionValue: I have come here to avenge my family.  One season past, they were attacked by a trio of deadly tigers.  I came here to hunt the beasts down, but then I found the local rangers and residents here protect the tigers.  They seem to be legends in these parts.  The tigers even have name's!!  They call them Eenot, Reggit and Kobb.  I wish I had help from a fellow monk.
